messages:
anya: Heads-up — after we promoted int4-v2 to 10% yesterday we saw an intermittent hallucination spike on longform summarization (mostly system prompts). Dashboard: https://dash.redwood.ai/r/abcd :thinking:
raj: saw same. Not constant — 0.3% -> 2.1% in a ~20m window then back down. Metric `hallucination_rate_longform_v2`.
oliver: can you paste sample ids? need to check slice vs noise.
anya: pasted a couple samples to thread: ```
ID: s-9843
prompt: "Summarize the following policy..."
model: int4-v2
output: "X is illegal..." (policy says it's allowed)
``` More examples in gist: https://gist.github.com/redwood/xyz.
eva: quick hypothesis — kv-cache mismatch with our int4 kernels on long contexts. we've seen token corruption before on similar builds.
raj: ran a shadow vs prod float16 compare on the 1k slice: delta_bleu -0.02, hallucination_rate +1.8pp. Degradation concentrated on seqlen>2k.
oliver: what's the auto-fallback configured at? I thought hallucination delta threshold was +1.5pp over rolling window.
maria: config shows +2.0pp over 10m for pilot promos. auto-fallback enabled=false for pilot by default (manual review flow). ci-bot did mark a quiet alert.
ci-bot: alert: quiet-hallucination-watch triggered for int4-v2 at 2026-03-20T14:12Z — delta +1.9pp over 10m; auto-fallback policy: enabled=false for pilot -> manual review required.
eva: propose enabling auto-fallback for pilot but conservative hysteresis: trigger at +1.5pp over 5m sustained for 3 windows, then fallback; require post-fallback smoke checks before re-promote.
anya: yes, and restrict signal to a slice tag `route:longform_system` so other routes don't dilute signal.
raj: I can push a canary-rule update: add slice tag filter `route:longform_system`, threshold +1.2pp 5m sustained(3). Rollout plan: shadow for 30m, then flip to canary for 5% if stable. Target deploy 2026-03-21 09:00 PT.
oliver: assigning rollback runbook to me. Steps: revert traffic to float16-wt on dedicated pool, verify kv-cache disable flag, and run post-mortem checklist (include sample csv and diff script).
maria: I'll update the auto-fallback config (enable=true for pilot) and notify on-call channel.
anya: also please add a smoke eval that runs N=100 seeds with seqlen sampled from the heavy tail (1k-4k) to catch this earlier.
eva: adding smoke-eval now, will run in staging and paste results back.
ci-bot: actioned: smoke-eval queued (job 84712). ETA ~12m.
raj: note: if smoke-eval fails, plan is auto-fallback -> float16 on canary + page eng-ml-oncall.
anya: good. let's monitor the smoke results and sync tomorrow 10:15 PT if still noisy. :thumbsup:
